continuity.campaign_development: January 59 BCE: Valerius ordered the majority of his men into the bandit-controlled estates. Several outer properties were abandoned before the Roman advance reached them, but one estate resisted and produced a hard fight. Recovered estate records exposed further relationships among properties, men and dispersed stores, while a night attack showed that the remaining bandit fighters could still contest occupied ground. The expedition ended the month holding several positions inside the estates with a stronger intelligence picture, but increased exhaustion, reduced supplies and more strained local relations.
